items.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.4 With Advanced Reasoning, Coding, and Computer-Use Capabilities
items.description: OpenAI on March 5, 2026, released GPT-5.4, its most capable and efficient frontier model to date, combining advanced reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows into a single unified system. items.title: PoC Exploit Released Cisco SD-WAN 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild
items.description: A public proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit has been released for CVE-2026-20127, a maximum-severity zero-day vulnerability in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and SD-WAN Manager that has been actively exploited in the wild since at least 2023.
